name: mio-integration-combined-arm-template
notes: The combined arm (two-regressor calibration plus the program-mode hedge) with its matched control (twin_warm, form identity, control true, no hedge). The walk must be run from configs/edge-calibration-template.json so its direction params equal the hedge's (else `block_params_disagree`), and read 2b must be PASS. Template, not a run config: nothing here is approved to run. RE-ENTRY Do-not list obeyed: development seal 2021-07-01 (no decision, fill, quote, mark or settlement at or past it; 2021Q3 and later never), no 2024+ data, no run log read, agents report counts, hashes and verdict words only. Every arm is a research arm BESIDE the nine locked formulations (A0010) on NEW method ids w1_010_shock10_cal_hedge_warm_lp, w1_010_shock10_cal_hedge_lp; the base formulation is w1_010_shock10_lp, its spec copied verbatim; locked_method_ids is the nine of the queue config. PREREQUISITES in order: (1) diagnostics first, no solve: the ADR-0310 Greeks diagnostics on the saved selection-quarter runs, `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <mio-greeks-<quarter>.json> --asof <date>`; (2) the arm is declared in docs/decisioning/attempts.jsonl BEFORE its first solve (family mio_integration). COMMANDS, repository root, one document at a time, NEVER edit this file or the output by hand: (a) `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python children/index_options/tools/mio_instantiate.py children/index_options/docs/plans/mio-json/combined-arm.template.json --base <quarter-run-doc>.json --name <name> --output-root <new run root> --edge-maps-pin <pin>.json --out <doc>.json` (the placeholders listed in `placeholders` are its arguments; it deep-merges study_overlay into the base run document's study and expands this pipeline; it refuses while any placeholder is unresolved); (b) `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline validate <doc>.json`; (c) `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <doc>.json --asof <quarter end>` (2021-06-30 for 2021Q2, then 2021-03-31 for 2021Q1, then 2020-03-31 for 2020Q1; exit 0 ran, 1 error or a refusal code, 3 halted). EVIDENCE: only the statuses `closed` or `insufficient` exist on the selection quarters (ADR-0313 section E); a quarter counts for a calibrated arm only with at least min_warm_weeks warm decision weeks; nothing here adopts an arm.

placeholders.meaning: the quarter's own resolved MIO run document (the one that ran the nine formulations): its plan node's study is the base the overlay is merged into
a JSON file with the onboarding pin of the published edge maps, acquired once after the walk's read words are PASS; never hand-written
the new document's name and a NEW run root

study_overlay.notes: Deep-merged by children/index_options/tools/mio_instantiate.py into the domain of the base quarter run document's study (dicts merge key by key; lists such as `methods` are replaced); `clocks` keeps every other key of the base and only pins tail_end_before.

edge_maps.pin: PLACEHOLDER: the onboarding pin of the published edge maps (never hand-written)

freeze_development.notes: The owner's explicit freeze of the quarter's packet (the same node the quarter run documents carry); its control port feeds open_packet.
